topic: 过去进行时与when/while的妙用 (Past Continuous Tense with 'when' & 'while')
teaching_notes: 同学们，过去进行时表示过去某个特定时刻或时间段正在发生的动作，结构是‘was/were + 动词ing’！当它和 when 或 while 连用时，就像在讲故事：when 后面常接突然发生的动作（用一般过去时），而 while 后面常接背景里一直在持续的动作（用过去进行时）。例如：*I was reading a book when the phone rang.*（我正在看书，突然电话响了。）或者 *While Mom was cooking, I was doing my homework.*（当妈妈在做饭时，我正在做作业。）记住哦，主语是单数用 was，复数用 were，可别写错啦！

questions.question: Yesterday at 4 PM, Toby ________ his dog in the neighborhood park.
questions.explanation: ‘Yesterday at 4 PM’表示过去具体的某一时刻，Toby 是单数第三人称，因此谓语动词要用过去进行时 was walking。

questions.question: What ________ you doing when the fire alarm rang during science class?
questions.explanation: 在过去进行时的特殊疑问句中，主语是 you，助动词要选用 were。

questions.question: Sarah was taking a photo ________ a colourful parrot suddenly flew into the frame.
questions.explanation: flew 是一般过去时（打断主句动作的瞬间动作），前面应用连词 when。

questions.question: While my parents ________ dinner, I was setting the dining table.
questions.explanation: while 引导的从句表示持续发生的背景动作，主语 my parents 是复数，故选用 were cooking。

questions.question: The athletes ________ on the running track when the thunder clap shook the stadium.
questions.explanation: run 的现在分词需要双写字母 n 再加 ing（running），主语 athletes 是复数，故选 were running。

questions.question: I didn't hear the doorbell ring because I ________ to classical music with headphones.
questions.explanation: 句意表示当时‘正在听音乐’，主语是第一人称 I，过去进行时结构为 was listening。

questions.question: Tim was ________ on the grass in the courtyard when his teacher called his name.
questions.explanation: 动词 lie（躺）的现在分词拼写变化为变 ie 为 y 加 ing，即 lying。

questions.question: What ________ your little sister making when you entered the kitchen?
questions.explanation: 主语 your little sister 是单数名词，过去进行时疑问句中使用助动词 was。

questions.question: While Mr. Harrison ________ the experiment, the students were taking notes carefully.
questions.explanation: while 表示同时进行的较长动作，Mr. Harrison 是单数，用 was demonstrating。

questions.question: The children ________ video games all morning yesterday.
questions.explanation: ‘all morning yesterday’强调过去整段时间正在进行的动作，主语 The children 为复数，用 were playing。

questions.question: Who ________ you talking to on the phone when I saw you in the hallway?
questions.explanation: 主语是 you，搭配过去进行时的疑问形式，需要填入 were。

questions.question: I accidentally dropped my ice cream while I ________ to catch the school bus.
questions.explanation: while 引导持续的动作，主语 I 用 was，run 的 ing 形式需双写 n 为 running。

questions.question: They ________ not listening to the announcements, so they missed the assembly.
questions.explanation: 主语 They 是复数，过去进行时的否定句结构为 were not + v-ing。

questions.question: At 8:00 last night, my older brother ________ his bicycle in the garage.
questions.explanation: 指定过去的具体时间点‘At 8:00 last night’，主语为单数，用 was repairing。

questions.question: While the teacher was speaking, David ________ key points in his notebook.
questions.explanation: 两个动作在过去同时发生，主句 David 是单数，故用 was writing。

questions.question: ________ it raining heavily when you left the school library?
questions.explanation: 主语 it 为单数代词，过去进行时一般疑问句句首用 Was。

questions.question: The sun ________ brightly when our class started the outdoor picnic.
questions.explanation: shine 去 e 加 ing 为 shining，主语 The sun 是单数，选用 was shining。

questions.question: My classmates ________ swimming while I was reading a magazine on the beach.
questions.explanation: 主语 My classmates 是复数，与 while 从句呼应，用 were (swimming)。

questions.question: At this exact time last Sunday, we ________ oil paintings in the art museum.
questions.explanation: ‘At this exact time last Sunday’指示过去具体时刻，主语 we 用 were admiring。

questions.question: Why ________ you crying when I bumped into you in the art room?
questions.explanation: 疑问词 Why 后紧跟助动词 were，与主语 you 保持一致。

questions.question: Lily made a minor calculation mistake while she ________ the challenging math puzzle.
questions.explanation: while 后接进行时态，主语 she 用 was solving。

questions.question: While the boys were playing football, the girls ________ rope on the playground.
questions.explanation: skip 需双写 p 再加 ing（skipping），主语 the girls 是复数，用 were skipping。

questions.question: Lucas lost his balance while he ________ his bike down the steep hill.
questions.explanation: ride 去 e 加 ing 为 riding，主语 Lucas 是单数，用 was riding。

questions.question: What were you and Emma doing when the electricity suddenly ________ off?
questions.explanation: when 引导打断正在进行动作的突发瞬间事件，停电用一般过去时 went。

questions.question: I ________ my teeth when my mom gently knocked on the bathroom door.
questions.explanation: 主语是 I，过去进行时为 was brushing，搭配 when 引导的过去时刻打断动作。

questions.question: The baby ________ peacefully in the cot until the loud alarm rang.
questions.explanation: 描述在过去响铃前持续的状态，The baby 是单数，用 was sleeping。

questions.question: While we were having lunch under the tree, a friendly squirrel ________ onto our table.
questions.explanation: while 从句表示进行中的背景（正在吃午饭），主句发生的突发动作（跳上桌）用一般过去时 jumped。

questions.question: The grade 5 students ________ their backpacks for the field trip all evening yesterday.
questions.explanation: prepare 去 e 加 ing 为 preparing，主语 The grade 5 students 为复数，用 were preparing。

questions.question: My dad ________ an exciting bedtime story when the lights flickered.
questions.explanation: My dad 是单数第三人称，过去进行时选用 was reading。

questions.question: ________ the pupils doing their group project when the bell chimed for lunch?
questions.explanation: 主语 the pupils 是复数名词，疑问句句首需要使用助动词 Were。
